note: Glyph, 2026-10-24. Numbers read from the lab (testbed/hud-style/world29.js) at play zoom 1080p, 38.6 px/m, ground flattened by 0.616. Widths are metres on the ground (what a LineRenderer takes). Every colour has a source; nothing new.
layer: the signal layer: unlit, emissive, outside the post grade; depth-tested so what stands in front of the ground hides it

civilianCone.read: Game.PersonCone(id).Kind == wedge: At, Facing, Reach 1300 cm, HalfCm 2252 (+-60 deg)
civilianCone.shape: a wedge, radii and the 13 m arc, rim only, no fill, no apex mark, still (it turns with the person)
civilianCone.cuts: Fan.Shadows and the walls and decks the host already clips: the rim is removed inside them; a rim of 0.05 m cream over 0.12 m ink-deep (alpha 0.55) follows every cut edge inside the wedge
civilianCone.deadGround: inside a Fan.Shadows polygon only: 45 deg hatch, cream 0.045 m lines on a 0.34 m pitch, alpha 0.7. Never a tint. Walls and decks are cut but not hatched.
civilianCone.showsWhen: hover (one wedge at a time) or Alt (the armed order's people, 6 nearest; the non-hovered at alpha 0.9) and: Game.CaresAbout(id, armedAct), or the person is on the armed card's eye (Quote.WitnessIds, TakedownQuote.People), or Game.NoticesNow(id, act, point) for an operative's seen act now. Below Alert 2 a Pressure, a run or Vale's grip draws none.
civilianCone.neverRed: a civilian is not a red signal; cream is the colour of the civilian hover ring (TARGET_RINGS.civilian)

securityFan.unchanged: wedge fill red 38 %, rim 0.085 m red, as built
securityFan.shadows: Fan.Shadows polygons are cut out of the fill and the rim; each cut gets a rim 0.045 m red (alpha 0.9) over 0.08 m ink-deep (alpha 0.45). No hatch: the ground shows through.
securityFan.ring: PersonSight.Kind == ring (security see all round within Reach): a closed ellipse, 0.07 m red over 0.14 m ink-deep (alpha 0.5), no fill, clipped like a fan; drawn on hover or Alt only when the armed act would count that person

nearBodyRing.read: PersonSight.NearCm (150 for a civilian on the street, 0 for security)
nearBodyRing.when: with that civilian's wedge, only while the armed order leaves or drops a body: a takedown (knockout or kill) or a drop. Not a carry, not a stash.
nearBodyRing.shape: a dashed ellipse at the feet, radius NearCm/100 m (57.9 px across x, 35.7 px down at play zoom), 36 dashes, 56 % on
nearBodyRing.why: a ring is a place, a wedge is a direction; dashed tells it from the hover ring (solid, 0.68 m) and from the security ring (solid, red)

moodDisc.read: Game.MoodOf(role): '' and neutral draw nothing; friendly, uneasy, scared draw one disc
moodDisc.disc: kit markers/disc_dark_24 on a 32 px element (the sprite's dark interior is 56 % of the element: keep the icon at 0.53, 17 px)
moodDisc.iconSpec: 64 px @2x, solid cream, cut-outs transparent; friendly = round head, open smile; uneasy = round head, eyes glancing right, flat mouth, one drop; scared = head over hunched shoulders, wide eyes, round mouth, two tremble marks
moodDisc.position: centred over the head, element bottom edge 2 px below the head top (about 54 px above the feet at play zoom)
moodDisc.max: two icons over a person: the mood disc and, beside it with a 3 px gap, the person's one other icon (status); nothing else

predictionMarks.likely: Quote.Likely: a plate_dark pill (nine-slice 0.37, 22 px) at the end of the price line before the faces: a dashed ring 15 px (cream, 1.5 px, 3.1 on / 2.3 off) with a check 8 px, then the word 'likely' (Jost 12.5)
predictionMarks.worse: Quote.Hurt: the same plate with a dashed ring holding a half disc; no word
predictionMarks.exact: after Listen: the kit's solid mark_ok / mark_half 15 px in the same plate, no word, no dash
predictionMarks.verbPlate: the same dashed marks 15 px at the lower right of the knob, no word

watch.notOffered: no row anywhere (action panel, ring, verbs 1-4, Intel's next step): rows close up in ContextRank order; the plate shows the next ranked verbs; trailing knobs, if fewer than four, use btn_verb_disabled as built; nothing struck, greyed or empty for 'nothing-to-see'; no pop, no pill, no sound
watch.afterWatch: already-watched greys the row as built; it returns if the mood changes

budget.measured: see qa/budget.json: 6.2 to 7.1 % at rest, 10 % with five pills on screen
